name: phone-alerts
description: Push a phone notification when a session waits for input, finishes, or fails, through ntfy.sh (free, no account) or your own Telegram bot. Pick which events alert and mute while you are at the desk.
author: yaam

tools.name: send_test

html:
📲 Phone alerts

A push to your phone when a session needs you or finishes.

Send throughntfy needs no account; Telegram uses your own bot
ntfy topicInstall the ntfy app and subscribe to this topic. Anyone who knows it can read it, so keep the random one.
Telegram chat idMessage your bot, then open api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates to find it. Put the bot token in Addons → phone-alerts → Secrets.
Needs inputapproval prompts and questions
Faileda session exited with an error
Finisheda session exited cleanly (one-shot runs)
Mutealerts are on

Alerts include the session name and its question. They leave this machine through ntfy.sh or api.telegram.org only.
